page.title: Tax, administrative, and amparo defense
page.summary: Defense against authority acts with analysis of deadlines, evidence, remedies, and amparo when applicable.
page.intro: Every authority act has timing and consequences. We organize the file, define the route, and make sure the strategy is supported by evidence.

cards.title: Deadline control
cards.description: We identify critical dates and consequences of each path before acting.

cards.title: Evidence and argument
cards.description: We integrate facts, documents, and legal criteria for a consistent defense.

cards.title: Route strategy
cards.description: We determine whether an administrative remedy, trial, amparo, or institutional negotiation is suitable.

page.trustTitle: Before acting, the matter is organized.
page.trustDescription: Each service starts with context, scope, and a responsible route. Sensitive information is requested only when the channel and objective are clear.

trustItems.title: Clear method
trustItems.description: Facts, documents, deadlines, and risks are separated before recommending an action.

trustItems.title: Information care
trustItems.description: The first contact stays general until scope and channel are confirmed.

trustItems.title: Multilingual attention
trustItems.description: The first approach can be prepared in Spanish, English, or Chinese depending on the matter.

page.moduleTitle: Deadlines, evidence, and route before responding.
page.moduleDescription: Defense against authorities requires a quick read of the act, its consequences, and evidence that can support the strategy.

moduleItems.title: Procedural clock
moduleItems.description: Critical dates are set to avoid late responses or lost routes.

moduleItems.title: Evidence matrix
moduleItems.description: Each argument is tied to facts, documents, and applicable criteria.

moduleItems.title: Route selection
moduleItems.description: Remedy, trial, amparo, or institutional conversation are compared by matter.

page.ctaTitle: Share the context before deciding the route.
page.ctaDescription: Astra Legal can review general context and identify a responsible next step. Do not send sensitive documents until the channel and scope are confirmed.
